text:
sarah: Hey team — new draft of the Dedicated launch blog is up: https://docs.google.com/redwood/dedicated-launch-v3. Quick things: 1) need legal eyeballs on claims, 2) final hero tagline pick, 3) confirm CTA routing + UTMs, and 4) confirm we have photo rights for the hero image. Target publish window: Mon 09:00 PT.

eli: reading now. can we A/B the hero? i put three options in the doc comments. Short poll here: A) 'Predictable inference, predictable costs' B) 'Consistent latency for real products' C) 'Ship LLM features with confidence' — vote with emoji.

toni: voted :one: for C — it speaks to product teams. Also legal: avoid "best"/"fastest".

maria: from data — small correction to numbers in the metrics callout. The 95th token latency we cited earlier was on mixed traffic; for the dedicated-sim run the 95th is actually 385 ms not 420. Full run: median 55 ms, 95th 385 ms, throughput ~8.5k tokens/s. I'll drop the CSV in the doc.

sarah: thanks maria — pls paste the exact sentence legal should use.

maria: paste this: `95th percentile per-token latency: 385 ms (internal benchmark, dedicated pool, A100-80GB, 64-token average; see raw results).`

derek: Design note: hero image v3 is attached in the doc (designbot uploaded). We need confirmation that the stock photo license was purchased. designbot: license ok, royalty-free, editorial+commercial.

designbot: uploaded: /assets/launch/hero-v3.png and license: https://licenses.stock/receipt/98765.

eli: legal — toni, can you weigh in on the bench phrasing? keep it conservative. Also we should add the caveat line "test conditions may not reflect production traffic patterns".

toni: yes to maria's sentence + the caveat. final recommended copy: `As measured in our internal benchmarks, the 95th percentile per-token latency was 385 ms (test conditions: 1k synthetic prompts, 64-token average, dedicated A100-80GB pool). Test conditions may not reflect production traffic patterns.`

sarah: perfect — i'll paste that into the hero callout and the benchmarks section.

maria: dropping link to raw results and run metadata: https://internal.redwood/bench/2026-04-05-dedicated-sim.csv

derek: CTA routing — current plan in the doc: main CTA -> demo form. Need UTMs from growth. matt? (not in thread) matt usually handles UTMs. can someone confirm utm params.

eli: suggest UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_q2. Also append `utm_content=hero-cta` for hero links.

sarah: added to the doc. For HubSpot mapping: form fields we need: email, company, seat_count (number), demo_tier (hidden logic), interest_tags. Kate is handling workflow but she's OOO til tomorrow — we must ensure mapping before publish.

maria: quick note on demo_tier logic — set enterprise if seat_count >=5 OR checkbox 'on-prem' checked. mid-market if seat_count 2-4, else self-serve. I'll add that as a comment in the doc.

derek: marketing ops: also capture `lead_channel=blog` hidden field so we can attribute in Salesforce.

eli: one more copy tweak — hero tagline poll results: :one: C, :two: A, :three: B. So C wins — "Ship LLM features with confidence". We should H1-focus on that and keep the benchmark callout as a small badge.

toni: legal final: approve provided the exact benchmark sentence + caveat are included and the license link for the hero is attached. Approving now.

sarah: noted approvals. design: lock hero and export responsive sizes. derek, any accessibility checks on the image contrast?

derek: contrast check passed. WCAG AA for 16px body comps.

designbot: exported hero images and pushed to CDN: https://cdn.redwood/launch/hero-v3-sets.zip.

publishbot: Hold set on publishing. Publish window Mon 09:00 PT. Publishing will require: legal sign-off, HubSpot form mapped, UTMs confirmed, hero assets uploaded.

sarah: final action list I have: 1) paste final bench sentence (done), 2) include raw results link (done), 3) finalize UTMs (eli done), 4) confirm HubSpot mapping (kate tomorrow), 5) confirm hero license (designbot done), 6) design export (done). If Kate signs off first thing tomorrow, i'll clear the hold and schedule.

eli: thumbs. I'll follow up with Kate in AM to confirm the HubSpot workflow.

toni: thanks y'all — great job getting this tighter.

maria: one last tiny ask: update the small benchmark explainer to say "internal benchmark" not "internal tests" for consistency.

sarah: updated. I'll ping again when the hold is released. :rocket:
